_comment: Versioned hedonic factor sets (remediation §3.3). The model resolves the set active at runtime by effective_from. No coefficients live in source files. Re-fit and append a new version once >=5,000 transactions/city are ingested — never edit a published version in place.

sets.source: PRD Part VII §7.2 initial priors (Fanr Cost Estimator multiplier structure + Saudi market practice); to be replaced by regression-fitted coefficients
sets.notes: Compound multiplier is clamped by the model to [0.80, 1.25] regardless of these values (remediation §3.2).
